no: Randy Huston, September 5, 2015, gives three constructions of X_3398: (1) Let X be the 2nd Brocard point of pedal triangle of 1st Brocard point. Let Y be the 1st Brocard point of pedal triangle of 2nd Brocard point. Then X_3398 is the vertex conjugate of X and Y. (2) Let U be the circle {{X_371,X_372,PU(1),PU(39)}} and V the 2nd Brocard circle. Then X_3398 is the center of the inverse-in-U of V. (3) Let A'B'C' be the 3rd Brocard triangle. Let Oa be the circumcenter of A'BC, and define Ob and Oc cyclically. The lines AOa, BOb, COc concur in X_3398.
